protocol.transform: sigmoid(logit-log(4)); retain raw sigmoid as a control
protocol.assessment_choice: Seal all mixtures/decisions and winner before assessment arrays are loaded
protocol.events: Original C30/C27 events, exact sampling metadata and target-array alignment checks
protocol.hypothesis: Correcting weighted-BCE odds may improve probability mixing and reveal a calibration rather than representation failure
protocol.theory_limit: Exact only for an ideal weighted BCE optimum; finite model, auxiliary speed loss, equal-event sampling and noise can still miscalibrate

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights
